message: No detected input validation: The code loads data from files and passes arrays through the pipeline without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards; NaN replacement is preprocessing, not validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local files (h5py, yaml) with no remote fetching, checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication mechanisms present in the code.

No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions against expected sets, validates label values, or uses any label-noise detection tool; labels are simply converted to one-hot encoding without anomaly checks.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The only data cleaning present is NaN imputation with column means; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a saved model via tf.keras.models.load_model() with only a path existence check, and performs no hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision validation before loading.

No detected label distribution validation: The code only prints label distribution when verbose=True (debug output), but performs no actual validation, assertion, or check on class balance or expected label sets before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation clustering, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense implemented anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The training code uses standard Keras model.fit() with no DP-SGD, TensorFlow Privacy, or Opacus integration.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test split is used, there is no signing, hashing, or cryptographic isolation of evaluation data, and the test set path is not protected against substitution or leakage.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads data and passes test_x directly to model.predict() with no shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: The predictions returned by model.predict() are passed directly to generate_result() without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a HAR (Human Activity Recognition) time-series classification model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
